prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1005; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not clear whether all of the damage came from this impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Rear bumper cover cracked and displaced, trunk lid edge deformed, and the left taillight assembly broken, with paint transfer along the rear quarter panel. Some of the lower tail panel damage may or may not stem from this impact, since the pattern is not fully clear from the photos, so that area is flagged for closer review. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and taillight, straightening the trunk lid edge, and refinishing the affected panels. The labor hours listed fit the damage described. The invoice lines show no repeated charges, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is known from the file or the owner's statement.
